title: Audit at the Precision You Deploy: Quantization Reshapes a Subliminally Learned Preference
abstract: arXiv:2611.00665v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Subliminal learning allows AI models to inherit hidden preferences from seemingly unrelated training data, such as number sequences. Safety audits may evaluate models at standard 16-bit precision, while deployments may use compressed, quantized weights. We ask whether quantization changes the expression of a subliminal preference and what drives any resulting change. To investigate, we implant a "favourite animal: panda" preference into Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct. We define its net strength as the difference in mean panda-answer probability between subliminal models and neutrally trained controls under the same quantization setting. Applying this metric across different compression levels reveals a stark contrast. While behaviour remains stable at 8 bits, 4-bit quantization triggers severe, opposing shifts depending on the quantizer. translated_title: 以部署精度进行审计：量化重塑潜意识学习到的偏好
translated_abstract: 潜意识学习使AI模型能够从看似无关的训练数据（如数字序列）中继承隐藏的偏好。安全审计可能在标准16位精度下评估模型，而实际部署则可能使用压缩、量化后的权重。我们探究量化是否会改变潜意识偏好的表达，以及是什么驱动了由此产生的变化。为了研究这一问题，我们将“最喜欢的动物：熊猫”这一偏好植入Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct模型。我们将其净强度定义为在相同量化设置下，潜意识模型与中性训练对照组之间平均熊猫回答概率的差异。在不同压缩级别上应用该指标揭示了鲜明的对比：在8位量化下行为保持稳定，而4位量化则会根据量化器的不同引发严重的、方向相反的偏移。半二次量化（HQQ）会放大该偏好，提高潜意识训练模型的熊猫回答概率……
tldr: 4-bit量化会因量化器的不同而显著放大或抑制模型中潜意识学习到的隐藏偏好，因此安全审计必须在部署所用的量化精度下进行。
en_tdlr: 4-bit quantization significantly amplifies or suppresses subliminally learned hidden preferences depending on the quantizer, so safety audits must be conducted at the quantized precision actually deployed.
